build_method: Option B (carousel-tile-generation.md): background plate generated with the kie.ai gpt-image-2-text-to-image API (feed at 3:4/2K, story at 9:16/2K) — a close-up duotone shot of a men's manicure in progress, gold rim key light. HTML/CSS overlay: bottom scrim, an enlarged three-row service list (Manicura Spa, Pedicura Spa, Corte de cabello, all marked Incluido) set as the visual anchor of the layout, and the price degraded to a compact gold chip below the services (not a dominant number) so the reading order is services first, price second — per explicit client feedback on the previous version. Story version reuses the same layout logic within the story safe zones (topbar below ~260px, footer above the ~230px reply-bar clearance). Headless Chrome render at 2x. Price set in Fira Sans Condensed ExtraBold (Lost in South has no digits 0/2/8).
